title: NERV: Local LLM Agent Orchestrator
description: Splits one query into typed subtasks, routes each to the local model best suited to it (a code model for debugging, a general model for explanation), runs them in dependency order and merges the results. v1.1 replaces the LLM planner with a trained MiniLM router: 0.89 grouped cross-validation accuracy, 18/20 on held-out bench tasks, and about 7 ms to plan where the LLM planner took about 45 s. Planner output is Pydantic-validated with a safe fallback, and routing is deterministic and unit-tested. Ollama only, no cloud APIs.
